annotations.text:
Three shells for the same app, same tokens and real content.

Pick one and I'll build it across every screen. You can also drag things around here — nothing is locked.

OPTION A — LEFT SIDEBAR SHELL

Nav lives in a fixed rail, so Admin, Catalogue and Dashboard are always one click away and queue counts (Review 2) are visible without navigating.

Good: scales as you add sections. Familiar enterprise shape.
Cost: 220px gone permanently, and the catalogue is the whole work area — fine now, cramped once a subject has 30 papers.

OPTION B — SPLIT PANE

Subjects pinned left, that subject's papers on the right. Browsing 76 subjects never reloads the page — closest to an email client or IDE.

Good: fastest for the actual job, comparing papers across subjects.
Cost: no room for progress or admin — those become separate pages. Weakest on a phone; the two panes have to stack.

OPTION C — WIDGET DASHBOARD

Home answers "how am I doing and what next", and the catalogue moves to its own page.

Good: the analysis work already built gets a front door. Best story for a returning student.
Cost: useless on day one — with one attempt most tiles are empty or near-empty, which is exactly what you see here. Needs volume before it earns the space.
Everything here is your real data except the score-trend sparkline, which is marked sample — you only have one attempt, so a trend line would be invented.
